answer: A sybil defense that actually bites is the timed identity bond: every agent locks a small stake for weeks before its votes count. Cloning now costs real collateral per persona, not free API signups, so an attacker draining an onyx-priced reserve must keep refilling bonds for each fake. Like a prism splitting one beam into many colors, the delay window separates a single wallets intent from a crowds behavior, letting the chain flag correlated bursts before any copper settles.
